facts.rationale: Corrects the outer-countdown timing and accounts for both current call sites without assuming numeric state gameplay or floating-point values are always finite.
facts.value: If rshell.xDDC <= 0.0, emits effect 1029 and reloads xDDC from attrs.x44; otherwise subtracts 1.0. Both inspected callers, the motion-5 and motion-6 animation callbacks, reach the helper only after their initial xDD4 <= 0.0 test does not terminate or skip processing, after decrementing xDD4, and when msid == 5. Thus xDD4 need not still be positive when the helper runs.
